principle: No household, worker, tenant, or shop may be assigned an automated displacement-risk score. Only aggregated evidence may inform a human-led public-interest review.

required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.question_zh: 不同收入和居住年限群体是否仍有可负担、可持续的居住选择？
minimum_fields: 统计网格或社区级住房数量
租赁/自有/保障性等聚合类型
空置与短租的聚合数量
数据日期、口径、样本量和误差
required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.minimum_spatial_release: 不少于统计网格/社区级，且满足隐私与样本量阈值后方可公开
required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.decision_boundary: AI 可做聚合趋势和情景比较；住房资格、搬迁、补偿和规划决定必须由有权主体依法作出。

required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.question_zh: 日常小店和低门槛服务是否能在更新后继续经营？
minimum_fields: 是否愿意续留及所需支持
forbidden_fields: 自动淘汰或招商排序分
required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.minimum_spatial_release: 仅发布聚合统计和经商户确认的自愿案例
required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.decision_boundary: AI 可识别服务类型缺口；不得决定商户去留、租赁条件或差别对待。

required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.question_zh: 园林、保洁、保安、维修、配送、餐饮等一线劳动者能否安全、可负担地抵达和使用基本服务？
minimum_fields: 夜间接驳与休息设施缺口
required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.minimum_spatial_release: 路线和班次信息须聚合、模糊化并经过劳动者代表复核
required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.decision_boundary: AI 只辅助发现可达断点；劳动安排、权益与安全由人和法定机制负责。

required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.question_zh: 原居民、租户、小店和一线劳动者是否真正参与了项目选择与复盘？
minimum_fields: 被采纳、未采纳和争议意见
forbidden_fields: 用平均意见替代少数反对意见
required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.minimum_spatial_release: 公开议题、分歧和回应，不公开可识别参与者
required_before_policy_or_project_decisi.decision_boundary: AI 可做议题归类和差异展示；不得把聚合结果冒充公共共识。

release_gate: Until all four missing evidence families have a documented method and human review, the retention stress test must remain diagnostic and cannot approve displacement, demolition, rent, tenure, procurement, or investment decisions.
